_evidence: Overlay for the HUD chain 0x524f38 -> 0x52537b (compose LAST, after ring_00525205 and tabs_00525595, which are wider than the game state for two fields this chain dereferences or divides by). (1) The 32-entry object table 0x6f2f6c: its only writer 0x55ab0e stores 'call 0x55ac8a; mov [ebx*4+0x6f2f6c],edi' where 0x55ac8a returns edi = 0x8943a0 + min(word & 0x3fff, [0x868558]-1)*0x160, i.e. always a record of the 0x160-stride ring - never 0 or 0xffffffff. 0x526da3 dereferences it ('mov edi,[ebx*4+0x6f2f6c]; ... movsx edx,word [edi+6]'): ring_00525205's 0/0xffffffff picks made the 2 faults at 0x526df4. Here every entry is one of the ring records 0..30 (both sides of 0x525205's pit-start compares remain: the pit start is a record 4..26). (2) The 32-entry table 0x6f346c: its only writer is 0x55abbf 'movsx eax,word [esi]; mov [ebx*4+0x6f346c],eax', so each entry is a sign-extended i16; 0x525595 copies the entry (or, when zero, the default dword [0x6f3970], which no instruction writes) to [0x6f398c] and 0x525784 divides by it: 'mov ebp,[0x6f398c]; test ebp,-1; jne; mov ebp,1; shl ebp,9; ... imul edx(0x140); idiv ebp'. tabs_00525595's 0x80000000 gives ebp = 0 (#DE, the 2 faults at 0x5257b1); an i16 x != 0 gives |x<<9| >= 0x200 and |[0x6f3b0c]*0x140 / ebp| <= 2^31*0.625, so no #DE/overflow for any dividend. Entries draw zero (default taken) and i16 values of both signs and extremes; the default draws nonzero synthetic values whose shl 9 is nonzero.
